correctness.rationale: For W_n=K_1 join C_n, n>=5, the diamond-conflict graph has spoke clique K_n, rim-edge cycle C_n, and precisely four forbidden spoke colours at rim r_i: indices i-1,i,i+1,i+2 mod n. A cyclic i+3 spoke-relative rim colouring attains the hub lower bound n. Every named-palette optimal colouring corresponds bijectively to one of n! spoke permutations and an independent-list rim assignment with cyclic inequalities, giving N_n=n!a_n. For independent uniform C_i in L_i, the adjacent-equality indicators have p=(n-5)/(n-4)^2; disjoint tuples contribute factorial moments 1, and k distinct events with c<k cyclic consecutive runs have O(n^c)(n-4)^(-k)=O(1/n) total. Hence Poisson(1) and N_n~e^(-1)n!(n-4)^n. Independent literal four-vertex diamond/conflict generation for n=5..12 and circular-list DP gave counts a_5..a_12=1,2,367,11966,400376,13440226,467622239,17062104558. This is a true asymptotic proof, not extrapolation of finite checks.
